Bruce A. Blakeman

Republican, Conservative, Vote Affordable candidate for Governor and Lt. Governor, New York · Challenger

Nassau County Executive

Bruce Blakeman is the Nassau County Executive and the Republican nominee for Governor of New York. He announced his campaign in December 2025 and is also on the ballot on the Conservative and Vote Affordable lines. His running mate is Todd Hood, and President Donald Trump has endorsed him.

Where Blakeman stands

Energy and utility costs
Says utility bills have risen about 50% under Gov. Hochul and has promised to cut them by 50%. Points to former Gov. Pataki's goal of 25% renewable electricity as a more reasonable target than the state's current climate goals.
Child care
Says child care is important but should go to parents who work. Supports giving working families a tax credit instead of expanding subsidized care.
Immigration enforcement
Defends Nassau County's cooperation with federal immigration authorities. Argues that the state's sanctuary policies lead to the enforcement actions.
Public safety
Opposes cashless bail, Raise the Age, the HALT Act and parole board leniency. Pledges to make subways and public transit safer.
Taxes
Says New York is the highest-taxed state in the country. Cites his elimination of $150 million in property tax increases that his predecessor had scheduled in Nassau County.
